interventions.title: Lane Markings and Road Diet
interventions.description: Paint clear lane lines and edge lines to narrow the perceived travel way and organize vehicle movement.

interventions.title: Vegetated Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip between the new sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.
